game.title: Snakes & Ladders
game.tagline: Lagos Edition. Ride the BRT, dodge the go-slow!
game.howto.1: Tap the die (or press Space) to roll. Your pawn hops that many squares. The first to reach square 100 wins.
game.howto.2: Land at the bottom of a ladder (BRT, okada, keke or the bridge) and ride up. Land on a pothole, go-slow, NEPA or toll queue and slide back down.
game.howto.3: You need the exact number to land on 100. Roll too high and you stay where you are (you can switch this in Rules).
game.howto.4: Once per game you can use Re-roll after you see your roll. You must keep the new roll.
game.howto.5: Every 5th turn you roll two dice and keep one. Tap a die, or press 1 or 2.
game.howto.6: On a keyboard: Space or Enter rolls and moves, R re-rolls, P or Esc pauses. The computer players follow the same rules.
rules.title: Rules
rules.note: The computer players follow the same rules as you.
rules.exact.help: You must land on 100 exactly. Roll too high and you stay put.
rules.reroll.help: Once per game, throw away your roll and roll again.
rules.choice.help: Roll two dice and keep the one you like.
